title: Top 5 Bollywood Grossers (1994-2019)
descriptions: The dataset contains a list of 130 top revenue grossing movies released in Bollywood between 1994-2019. The dataset also contains several other details like the genre, box-office collection, release dates and the storyline. The dataset has been compiled from different sources like BoxOfficeIndia.com, IMDB.com and Wikipedia websites.
